lessons.title: 1. Defining a Class & __init__
lessons.description: In Python, classes are defined using the `class` keyword. The `__init__` constructor initializes object attributes. Create a `Wizard` class with `name` and `health` attributes.
learning_objectives: Define a class with an __init__ constructor method

tests.name: test_wizard_init
tests.unittest_code:
def test_wizard_init(self):
    w = Wizard("Gandalf", 120)
    self.assertEqual(w.name, "Gandalf")
    self.assertEqual(w.health, 120)

lessons.title: 2. Instance Methods
lessons.description: Instance methods take `self` as their first parameter and can modify or read instance state. Add a `take_damage(amount)` method to `Wizard`.
learning_objectives: Define instance methods that modify instance attributes

tests.name: test_take_damage
tests.unittest_code:
def test_take_damage(self):
    w = Wizard("Merlin", 100)
    w.take_damage(30)
    self.assertEqual(w.health, 70)

lessons.title: 3. Space Station Life Support (Concept Challenge)
lessons.description: Model a SpaceStation with crew count, oxygen level, and life support methods.
learning_objectives: Build a complete class modeling real-world system state

tests.name: test_add_crew
tests.unittest_code:
def test_add_crew(self):
    station = SpaceStation("ISS", 2)
    station.add_crew_member("Alice")
    self.assertEqual(station.crew, ["Alice"])

tests.name: test_consume_oxygen
tests.unittest_code:
def test_consume_oxygen(self):
    station = SpaceStation("ISS", 5)
    station.add_crew_member("Alice")
    station.add_crew_member("Bob")
    station.consume_oxygen(5)
    self.assertEqual(station.oxygen_level, 80)

lessons.title: 4. Bank Account Transaction Log (Practice)
lessons.description: Implement a `BankAccount` class with `deposit`, `withdraw`, and balance history.
learning_objectives: Encapsulate state and transaction logic in a class

tests.name: test_bank_account
tests.unittest_code:
def test_bank_account(self):
    acc = BankAccount("Charlie", 100)
    acc.deposit(50)
    self.assertEqual(acc.balance, 150)
    self.assertTrue(acc.withdraw(30))
    self.assertEqual(acc.balance, 120)
    self.assertFalse(acc.withdraw(500))

lessons.title: 5. Unit 14 Checkpoint: Classes Mastery
lessons.description: Verify your understanding of Python classes and object instantiation.
